pages.name: Consent page
pages.content:
Your participation in this study is entirely voluntary, and you have the right to withdraw at any time without penalty or negative consequences.
If you choose to withdraw, any data collected from you will be deleted and excluded from the final analysis.

The purpose of this study is to evaluate perceptions of different versions of a virtual character.
You will be asked to watch 17 videos featuring a virtual character and answer questions about your perception of their behavior.
Finally, we will collect some demographic information to ensure balanced demographic representation.

This study will take approximately 15 minutes to complete, and you will receive a compensation of $2.25.
The data collected in this study will be used solely for research purposes.

If you have any questions, concerns, or feedback regarding this study, please feel free to contact Lucie Galland at lucie.galland@lis-lab.fr.

Click "Next" to provide your consent.

pages.name: Instructions page: Please read these instructions carefully and answer the following questions
pages.content:
In the following, you will watch videos of a virtual character acting as help during a trivia quizz.
The trivia questions are based on made-up facts; you can not find the answer on the internet or in your knowledge. You do not know how much the agent know about the subject.
The time you spend on each page is recorded and we will not be able to reward you if you answer quicker than the length of the videos.



Please answer the following questions to ensure you understood these instructions.
question: QAtt1
Your goal is to answer the questions rightfully ?
QAtt2
Can you find the right answer on the internet?
QAtt3
The virtual character will help you answer the questions ?
QAtt4
The virtual agent knows about all the subjects asked about?
QAtt1
I am going to get payed even if I do not watch the videos fully ?
